label: Generic organization
description: Any organization whose documents describe its facilities, systems and procedures. No built-in identifier categories: the project's documents are the only source.

vocabulary.frontline: front-line supervisors, dispatchers, help-desk staff, security officers

ot: the operational systems the documents name

roles.name: Director of Operations (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the facility, the service and the people.

roles.name: IT Director (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns the systems and the investigation.

roles.name: Public Information Officer
roles.description: Owns the narrative: social media, press, the website.

roles.name: Security Manager
roles.description: Owns physical security and the law-enforcement liaison.

roles.name: Partner / Tenant Liaison
roles.description: Owns the partners, tenants or customers the incident affects.

outsideParties: the system vendors the documents name

sceneAnchors.public: inside an organization's main lobby: a reception desk, a few visitors, glass doors, daylight
sceneAnchors.control: inside an operations center: a table of laptops and phones, a whiteboard, staff in lanyards, fluorescent light
sceneAnchors.exterior: outside an office building entrance: a parking lot with a few cars, a flagpole, overcast daylight

noiseExamples: a vendor asking for a visitor badge
pressureExamples: a customer post with a photo
a partner demanding a written update
a board member calling the director
